stories.title: Korda vs. Ryu — The AIG Women's Open Matchup That Defines the Year

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Nelly Korda and Haeran Ryu tee off together Thursday at Royal Lytham.

Together they've won all four 2026 women's majors. One more win for either = three in a calendar year — Inbee Park's 2013 record.

The season's biggest matchup starts at 8:42 AM local. #AIGWO

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
AIG Women's Open R1 groupings are set:

8:42 AM — Korda, Haeran Ryu, Lydia Ko
1:15 PM — Yamashita (defending), Jeeno Thitikul
1:26 PM — Charley Hull, Hannah Green, Brooke Henderson

$10M purse. Par 71. 174 bunkers. Royal Lytham. #AIGWO

stories.title: It's Official — LIV Golf's Michigan Season Finale Is Canceled

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Official: LIV Golf has canceled the $40M Michigan season finale.

Two events left in 2026 — Bedminster (Aug 6-9) and Indianapolis (Aug 20-23). When asked if he could guarantee those happen, CEO Scott O'Neil said he couldn't. #LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
LIV's 2026 season started with 14 events.

New Orleans: canceled.
Michigan: canceled.

12 of 14 completed or surviving. CEO can't guarantee the last two. The season that was supposed to change golf is finishing with two $30M events. #LIVGolf

article.headline: LIV Golf Cancels Michigan — The $40M Season Finale Is Off, Two Events Remain

stories.title: LIV Golf's Financial Collapse — £461M in Losses, $100M Monthly Burn, Chapter 11 on the Table

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The numbers behind LIV's collapse:

• £461.8M lost in 2024 alone
• ~$100M monthly burn
• $8.50 spent for every $1 earned
• PIF pulling funding after 2026 ($5B+ invested since 2022)
• Bloomberg: Chapter 11 bankruptcy being planned

Five billion dollars. Three years. #LIVGolf

stories.title: The Last Rocket Classic — FedExCup Bubble Begins This Week

x_posts.label: Post 4

The last Rocket Classic starts Thursday.

Rocket Companies is exiting after 2026. Detroit Golf Club hosts the final edition — 500 FedExCup points on the line with two events left in the regular season. The bubble tightens. #RocketClassic #FedExCup

stories.title: What Koivun's 3M Win Actually Means — FedExCup Math, Rookie Year Arc, What's Next

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Koivun turned pro ~24 days before winning the 3M Open in his third start.

He's now in the FedExCup Playoffs. He's 21. He beat Scheffler — who shot 63 and still lost by 3.

One of the most unusual rookie arcs in recent Tour history. #PGATour

article.headline: From Third Start to FedExCup Playoffs — Jackson Koivun's Historic Summer Just Got More Historic
